name: the Homelands
note: A zone of the disc for each race of racedefs past the game's, where it stands on the disc (no two in one cell of the grid). Built by cmd/worldbuild from the operator's disc; the content (start, people, quests) is tools/seed_race_homes.py's.

zones.name: West Plateau
zones.note: Hill Giant: the hill giants' plateau: 73 hill giants of the game stand in it (West Plateau, cell 3,1)

zones.name: Kerra Isle
zones.note: Kerran: the kerrans' island, its village and sentries (Kerra Isle, cell 2,3)

zones.name: Moss Mouth Cavern
zones.note: Goblin: a goblin cavern town: 87 goblins of the game, a blacksmith among them (Moss Mouth Cavern, cell 9,6)

home.flavor: Goblins are crafty folk of Moss Mouth Cavern in the Homelands, quick with a blade and quicker to flee, who serve the dark elves of Neriak.

npcs.name: Elder Snikkit
npcs.note: the starter quests' giver, in a witch doctor's look, in the middle of the cavern's great hall

npcs.name: Grocer Mudgrub
npcs.note: the cavern's grocer, in the blacksmith's look, a Neriak grocer's food

npcs.name: Spiritmaster Grizzik
npcs.note: binds, as every spiritmaster; a goblin seer's look

npcs.name: Gatekeeper Skabber
npcs.note: sends a goblin who has done the starter quests to Neriak (the quest The Road to Neriak); a goblin warrior's look

npcs.name: tunnel rat
npcs.note: the starter quest's rats, at the dire wolves' spots in the hall's pit

Gatekeeper Skabber: Not so fast, little one. Do what Elder Snikkit asks of you first, then come back to me.
No one leaves Moss Mouth until the elder says so. He waits in the middle of the great hall.
Moss Mouth lookout: Keep moving, %r. Lookouts do not chat.
If you hear something in the dark, it is probably a rat. Probably.
New, are you? Elder Snikkit wants to see every new face. He waits in the middle of the hall.
Elder Snikkit: Mind Mudgrub and mind Skabber, and you will do well, little one.
A goblin who keeps his ears open lives long enough to grow wise. Look at me.

zones.name: Aviak Village
zones.note: Aviak: the aviaks' savannah village: 173 aviaks of the game, a grocer and guards among them (Aviak Village, cell 4,10)

home.flavor: Aviaks are watchful bird folk of the savannah aeries in the Homelands, whose fledglings fly north to fight beside the barbarians of Halas.

npcs.name: Elder Kraawk
npcs.note: the starter quests' giver, in the high priest's robes

npcs.name: Grocer Skreel
npcs.note: the Roost's grocer, a Halas merchant's food

npcs.name: Spiritmaster Kreeal
npcs.note: binds, as every spiritmaster

npcs.name: Gatekeeper Windwhistle
npcs.note: sends a fledgling who has done the starter quests to Halas (the quest The Long Flight)

npcs.name: scrub rat
npcs.note: the starter quest's rats, at the grave rats' spots south of the nests

zones.name: Cazic-Thule
zones.note: Lizardman: the Tae Ew lizardmen's temple in the swamp (Cazic-Thule, cell 7,15)

home.flavor: Lizardmen are cold-blooded hunters of the swamps of Cazic-Thule in the Homelands, patient and tireless, who sell their blades in Freeport.

npcs.name: Elder Hsslarn
npcs.note: the starter quests' giver, in a hierophant's robes, on the west shore before the old temple

npcs.name: Grocer Sskaya
npcs.note: the swamp's grocer at the long bridge's west end, in the race's own body; a Freeport grocer's food

npcs.name: Spiritmaster Thessik
npcs.note: binds, as every spiritmaster; before the old temple

npcs.name: Gatekeeper Vosskar
npcs.note: sends a lizardman who has done the starter quests to Freeport (The Road to Freeport); on the east island, over the long bridge

npcs.name: bog beetle
npcs.note: the starter quest's beetles, at the Tae Ew's spots on the southern banks

Gatekeeper Vosskar: Not yet, hatchling. Elder Hsslarn has work for you first.
Every hatchling sees the elder before it sees Freeport. He waits on the west shore, before the old temple.
Mirewatch sentinel: The water is calm today. Calm water hides the most.
Stay on the bridges, %r. The mud has no bottom in places.
New to the swamp? Elder Hsslarn waits on the west shore, before the old temple.
Elder Hsslarn: Patience, hatchling. The swamp rewards those who wait.
Keep your scales dry and your blade sharp, and the mainland will treat you well.

zones.name: Sylhilthis' Dwell
zones.note: Kappa: the kappa town of Odus: 179 kappa of the game, guards and a blacksmith (Sylhilthis' Dwell, cell 2,1)

zones.name: Mayfly Glade
zones.note: Brownie: a glade (the brownies' own Salisearaneen stands in the Warrens' cell) (Mayfly Glade, cell 5,9)

home.flavor: Brownies are quick-fingered fae of Mayfly Glade in the Homelands, fond of mischief and a good meal, and friends to the halflings of Rivervale.

npcs.name: Elder Thimbleroot
npcs.note: the starter quests' giver, a brownie elder of Salisearaneen's, east of the hut in the glade's stockade (the Glinaldal camp's spots: no brownie stands in the zone)

npcs.name: Grocer Pippkin
npcs.note: the glade's larder by the tent, a Rivervale grocer's food

npcs.name: Spiritmaster Fennick
npcs.note: binds, as every spiritmaster

npcs.name: Gatekeeper Burrowby
npcs.note: sends a brownie who has done the starter quests to Rivervale (The Road to Rivervale); at the stockade's gate

npcs.name: Glade watcher
npcs.note: outside the gate, on the ground

npcs.name: mayfly swarm
npcs.note: the starter quest's mayflies, at the sacred monarchs' spots in the open glade west of the stockade

Gatekeeper Burrowby: Off to Rivervale already? Not before the elder has had a word with you. He is just inside, by the hut.
Elder Thimbleroot first, then me. That is the way of the glade.
Glade watcher: Lovely day for it, whatever it is.
Keep your fingers out of Pippkin's larder, %r. She counts more than she says.
The stockade keeps out the wolves. Mostly.
Elder Thimbleroot: A brownie with a full belly is a brownie ready for anything.
Rivervale is a fine place. The halflings bake almost as well as we do.

zones.name: Misty Thicket
zones.note: Pixie: the bixies' thicket (Misty Thicket, cell 8,5)

home.flavor: Pixies are tiny winged fae of the Misty Thicket in the Homelands, bright as sparks and twice as quick, who learn the old magic among the elves.

npcs.name: Elder Brightwing
npcs.note: the starter quests' giver, under the tall pines in the middle of the thicket, at the bixies' spots

npcs.name: Grocer Nettlewick
npcs.note: the thicket's grocer by the old pines to the east, an elven grocer's food

npcs.name: Spiritmaster Glimmerdew
npcs.note: binds, as every spiritmaster

npcs.name: Gatekeeper Thistlewhirl
npcs.note: sends a pixie who has done the starter quests to the elves, Tethelin or Fayspire by class (The Elves' Wood)

npcs.name: bramble rat
npcs.note: the starter quest's rats, at the wolf spiders' and their neighbours' spots in the brambles to the south-west

Gatekeeper Thistlewhirl: Not yet, little spark. Elder Brightwing wants a word with you first.
Every pixie sees the elder before the elves see the pixie. Off you go!
Thicket warden: Watch the brambles, %r. The rats are bolder than they look.
Mist on the leaves means rain by evening.
Lost? Elder Brightwing is under the tall pines in the middle of the thicket.
Elder Brightwing: The thicket remembers every pixie it has raised. It will remember you.
Be quick, be kind, and never let a goblin near your purse.

zones.name: Twisted Tower
zones.note: Fairy: a faerie town: a blacksmith, druids and wizards of the game (Twisted Tower, cell 3,5)

home.flavor: Fairies are winged fae of the Twisted Tower in the Homelands, quick to laugh and light as thistledown, who go to the humans of Qeynos.

npcs.name: Elder Moonpetal
npcs.note: the starter quests' giver, in the middle of the faeries' valley, at Sprinkletine's spot

npcs.name: Grocer Dewberry
npcs.note: the faerie grocer's look, by the old forge; a Qeynos grocer's food

npcs.name: Spiritmaster Lirelle
npcs.note: binds, as every spiritmaster

npcs.name: Gatekeeper Starling
npcs.note: sends a fairy who has done the starter quests to Qeynos, its rangers and druids to Surefall Glade (The Road to Qeynos); toward the pass

npcs.name: dusk beetle
npcs.note: the starter quest's beetles, at the faeries' spots in the gardens at either end of the valley

Gatekeeper Starling: Not yet, little friend. Elder Moonpetal is waiting to meet you.
Elder Moonpetal sees every new fairy first. She is in the middle of the valley, south of here.
Tower watcher: The pass is quiet today. Good.
Mind the drakes up on the slopes, %r. They do not care how small you are.
If you are new, see Elder Moonpetal. Everyone does.
Elder Moonpetal: Laugh often, little friend. It is the oldest magic there is.
The valley will always remember you, wherever the winds take you.

zones.name: Blackburrow
zones.note: Gnoll: the gnolls' burrow: 124 gnolls of the game (Blackburrow, cell 6,6)

home.flavor: Gnolls are hyena-faced hunters of Blackburrow in the Homelands, cunning in a pack and fierce alone, who serve the dark elves of Neriak.

npcs.name: Elder Grawl
npcs.note: the starter quests' giver, a spiritist's look, by the fire pit of the gnolls' stockade south of the burrow

npcs.name: Grocer Snaggle
npcs.note: a forager's look, by the cook pots; a Neriak grocer's food

npcs.name: Spiritmaster Rakk
npcs.note: binds, as every spiritmaster; a shaman's look

npcs.name: Gatekeeper Brindle
npcs.note: sends a gnoll who has done the starter quests to Neriak (The Road to Neriak); at the stockade's south-east gate

npcs.name: hill badger
npcs.note: the starter quest's badgers, at a creature camp's spots on the hill north-west of the stockade

Gatekeeper Brindle: Not yet, pup. Elder Grawl has to know your scent before Neriak does.
Go and see Elder Grawl by the fire. Then we will talk.
Burrow guard: Nothing moves on the hill that I do not see.
Keep your nose up, %r. Trouble smells before it shows.
New pup? Elder Grawl is by the fire pit.
Elder Grawl: The pack is strong because each gnoll is strong. Remember that.
Wherever you go, pup, the pack goes with you.

zones.name: Thedruk
zones.note: Orc: the Hatebone orcs' camp: 93 orcs of the game, a prophet among them (Thedruk, cell 9,4)

home.flavor: Orcs are tusked warriors of the Thedruk camps in the Homelands, hard as stone, who keep a rough peace with the barbarians of Halas.

npcs.name: Elder Gorruk
npcs.note: the starter quests' giver, a prophet's look, among the totems of the Hatebone camp east of the river

npcs.name: Grocer Bulgash
npcs.note: a henchman's look, at the camp's cook fire; a Halas grocer's food

npcs.name: Spiritmaster Urzog
npcs.note: binds, as every spiritmaster; a mystic's look

npcs.name: Gatekeeper Thrakka
npcs.note: sends an orc who has done the starter quests to Halas (The Road to Halas); a scout's look

npcs.name: camp rat
npcs.note: the starter quest's rats, at the orc raiders' spots on the slope west of the camp

Gatekeeper Thrakka: Not yet, whelp. Elder Gorruk speaks to every new orc first.
Go and see the elder among the totems. Then come back, and I will send you to Halas.
Thedruk sentry: The camp sleeps easier when I do not.
Looking for the elder? He is among the totems in the middle of the camp.
Elder Gorruk: An orc is measured by the fights he finishes, not the ones he starts.

zones.name: The Warrens
zones.note: Kobold: the kobolds' tunnels: 114 of clan Kolbok (The Warrens, cell 4,4)

zones.name: Gerntar Mines
zones.note: Minotaur: the Rustel minotaurs' mines: 41 minotaurs of the game (Gerntar Mines, cell 6,13)

home.flavor: Minotaurs are bull-headed brutes of the Gerntar Mines in the Homelands, proud and quick to anger, who throw in their lot with the trolls of Grobb.

npcs.name: Elder Hornbrand
npcs.note: the starter quests' giver, Gilthirn Ironhoof's look, at the mouth of the Rustel minotaurs' mine

npcs.name: Grocer Brassnose
npcs.note: by the mine cart outside; a Grobb barkeep's food

npcs.name: Spiritmaster Ruhga
npcs.note: binds, as every spiritmaster; Khelmarak's look, at Bribro Mino's spot in the mine

npcs.name: Gatekeeper Stonehoof
npcs.note: sends a minotaur who has done the starter quests to Grobb (The Road to Grobb); at the next mine's mouth to the south

npcs.name: mine rat
npcs.note: the starter quest's rats, at the savannah creatures' spots in the grass east of the mine

Gatekeeper Stonehoof: Not so fast, calf. Elder Hornbrand sees every new minotaur first.
The elder is at the mouth of the mine to the north. See him, then see me.
Rustel sentry: The mine is ours. Remember that.
Watch your horns in the tunnels, %r. The ceilings are low.
New calf? Elder Hornbrand stands at the mouth of the mine.
Elder Hornbrand: Pride is a fine thing, calf. So is patience. Learn both.
The herd remembers its own, wherever they roam.

zones.name: The Vastly Deep
zones.note: Ratman: the ratmen's coast caves (The Vastly Deep, cell 5,3)

zones.name: East Toxxulia
zones.note: Satyr: the satyrs' woods: 155 acolyte satyrs of the game (East Toxxulia, cell 3,2)

zones.name: West Toxxulia
zones.note: Dryad: the forest dryads' woods (West Toxxulia, cell 2,2)

zones.name: Tomb of Kings
zones.note: Skeleton: a crypt of the old kings (Tomb of Kings, cell 10,7)

home.flavor: Skeletons are the restless dead of the Tomb of Kings in the Homelands, held to their bones by a will that would not die, who walk on to Freeport.

npcs.name: Elder Ossric
npcs.note: the starter quests' giver, a Holciel noble's look, in the tomb's great hall

npcs.name: Grocer Marrowby
npcs.note: a Holciel commoner's look, down the hall; a Freeport grocer's food, for the living he trades with

npcs.name: Spiritmaster Vellum
npcs.note: binds, as every spiritmaster; a Holciel bureaucrat's look

npcs.name: Gatekeeper Dustcloak
npcs.note: sends a skeleton who has done the starter quests to Freeport (The Road to Freeport); toward the tomb's door

npcs.name: tomb beetle
npcs.note: the starter quest's beetles, at the Holciel guards' spots in the west halls

Gatekeeper Dustcloak: Not yet. Elder Ossric speaks to every one of us who wakes.
See the elder in the great hall. Then come back to me.
Tomb sentinel: The halls are quiet. They are always quiet.
Keep to the lit halls, %r. The dark ones go on for a long way.
Newly woken? Elder Ossric is in the great hall.
Elder Ossric: Death was not an ending for us. Only a long rest, and the rest is over.
Walk among the living, and be patient with them. They have so little time.

zones.name: Guk
zones.note: Fungusman: the fungal folk's caverns (Guk's) (Guk, cell 12,14)

home.flavor: Fungusmen are slow, gentle mushroom folk of the caverns of Guk in the Homelands, whose spores drift up into the shaded glades of the elves.

npcs.name: Elder Moldcap
npcs.note: the starter quests' giver, a fungal elder of the funagl hall deep in Guk, at its own spot by the hall's west wall

npcs.name: Grocer Puffstool
npcs.note: the funagl gatherer's look and spot by the hall's north wall; an elven grocer's food and drink

npcs.name: Spiritmaster Sporewell
npcs.note: binds, as every spiritmaster; the funagl devout's look

npcs.name: Gatekeeper Gillford
npcs.note: sends a fungusman who has done the starter quests to the elves, Tethelin or Fayspire by class (Up to the Light)

npcs.name: cave beetle
npcs.note: the starter quest's beetles, at the frogloks' spots by the hall's east passage

Gatekeeper Gillford: Not yet, sprout. Elder Moldcap greets every new one first.
See the elder by the west wall. There is no hurry, but it must be done.
Guk sporeguard: All is quiet in the hall.
Slow and steady, %r. The caverns do not reward haste.
New sprout? Elder Moldcap is by the west wall.
Elder Moldcap: A spore that waits for the right ground grows the tallest cap.
Up above it is bright and dry. Carry a little of the damp with you.

zones.name: West Feerrott
zones.note: Wisp: the will o' wisps' swamp: 34 wisps of the game in the race's own body (0x8143DC70) float in it, more than anywhere else (West Feerrott, cell 3,4)

zones.name: South Barren Coast
zones.note: Gargoyle: the gargoyles' crags: 91 gargoyles of the game (South Barren Coast, cell 5,4)
